data_fields.name: superset_ladder_thresholds
data_fields.donor_constant: flags added at levels below 9, 8, 7, 6, 5, 4, 3, 2, 1 (default ladder)

data_fields.name: chat_spam_window_argument
data_fields.donor_constant: 500 (argument to the spam helper; unit and semantics not read)

data_fields.name: staff_bypass_privilege
data_fields.donor_constant: account privilege above 1 passes every rank check

best_idea: Store one ladder of ranks by level, where each level is a superset of the level below, and gate every guild action through one server-side permission check that reads the rank's flag, with the leader defined as level 0 and chat hearing checked per recipient.
decision_why: Keep the single permission check, the superset ladder as data and the per-recipient hear check; give Demote its own flag instead of the donor's Promote alias, and add a server guard that keeps exactly one level-0 rank.
acceptance: A server test where a rank-2 officer (default ladder: invite and promote, no remove) can invite but not remove a member; a new member (rank 9) can hear guild chat but a guild send is refused; a leader edit that would leave no level-0 rank, or two, is refused with a message.
